cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied the address from your envelope. Verification complete. The birthday invitations failed somewhere in mailing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's marked return to sender. You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Returns logged. The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then address verification needs another checker. Read the new list to dispatch; we'll rewrite the envelopes.
